serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Damn…{{wi}} it must be tough for her.
Bot: Yeah.
Bot: I guess there are all sorts of people out there.
You: Well, of course there are. 
Bot: Well, only recently I talked to other people than you. It’s all really new to me.
You: Right. Sorry. Sometimes I forget that most of your life you spent in my room.
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Don’t be sorry. I’m glad that you are my master.
You: W-well, if you say so.
She’s so sweet!
